title: Award NC Forest Service Pay Increase
lastAction: Ref to the Com on Appropriations, if favorable, Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
aiSummary: This bill appropriates $2.6 million for fiscal year 2025-2026 and $5.2 million for fiscal year 2026-2027 to give North Carolina Forest Service employees a 7.5% salary increase in each year, beginning July 1, 2025.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue that Forest Service employees deserve competitive wages to attract and retain skilled workers in important roles managing North Carolina's forests and preventing wildfires. They contend that pay increases help address employee recruitment challenges and recognize the value of public servants who perform essential environmental and safety work for the state.
aiConArguments: Opponents may argue that the state should prioritize other budget needs or that the 7.5% increase twice in two years is costly when the state faces competing financial pressures. They might also question whether this targeted increase is fair compared to salary needs across other state agencies and departments.
